name: software
description: Take a change from idea to production, in one plugin. Decide: interview-me, grilling, spec, requirement-convergence. Shape: ddd runs the nine-step DDD Starter Modelling Process with validators, a review page, diagrams and recorded decisions; Blueprint renders architecture, sequence, workflow, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams; ADRs, contracts, module design. Understand: core primes a repo with a knowledge graph and keys keeps one AGENTS.md tree; trace, research-codebase, deepwiki, explain-diff. Build: a planned pipeline from brainstorm to change-description, with tdd, debug, swarm and unlazy. Verify: code-sweep review, complexity, blast radius, verify-feature, harnesses and test suites. Secure: security-sweep. Ship: ship-gate, SLOs, flags, CI/CD, migrations. Principles and stack references are router skills that load one guide at a time. The DDD and Blueprint tools require Node.js 18 or newer. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.
